initiative: Original eight native parks and Basketball Long

requests.label: one-court Basketball aerial
requests.prompt: Aerial photo finish of this exact scene. Keep one basketball court with two hoops and its fence, the pedestrian plaza south, and the separate conservatory garden east. Preserve positions, dimensions, object counts and this camera; refine only daylight and material realism.
requests.visual_review: Broad geometry and layout preserved at aerial scale. Individual hoop/furniture counts are too small to verify definitively.

requests.label: two-court Long Basketball street
requests.prompt: Street-height photo finish of this exact scene. Preserve the two separate fenced basketball courts, four hoops, central access path, and pedestrian plaza in front. Keep camera, dimensions, positions and planting; refine only daylight and materials.
requests.source_limit: Two courts are visible behind fencing and partly occluded by plaza stalls and lamps.
requests.visual_review: Both fenced courts and plaza/stalls remain in the same arrangement; exact hoop and small furnishing counts are partly occluded at street level.

requests.label: Botanical garden walking height
requests.prompt: Walking-height photo finish of this exact botanical garden. Preserve the curving paved path, dense flowering beds, central fountain and domed conservatory in their current positions. Keep this camera, planting layout and structure; refine only natural light and materials.
requests.visual_review: Conservatory, split curving path, flower beds and fountain remain in the same arrangement; material and lighting realism improve.

requests.label: mixed eight native parks aerial
requests.prompt: Overhead photo finish of this exact site. Preserve all eight separate park layouts, the single basketball court, all paths and planting, both Market street approaches, footprints, orientations and this camera. Refine only natural daylight and material realism; add no new objects.
requests.visual_review: All eight separate park programs, connected Market roads, single basketball court, and main path/planting shapes remain in the same overhead arrangement. Fine element counts are below audit scale.

requests.label: Teaching Demonstration Garden south entrance street
requests.prompt: Street-height photo finish of this exact Teaching Demonstration Garden from its south entrance. Preserve the central paved approach, raised planting beds, arch, side paths, surrounding street connection, object positions and this camera. Refine only daylight, plants and material realism; add no objects.
requests.visual_review: South entry connector, main axis, raised beds and central arch retain the same positions and camera; textures and daylight improve. Individual small plant counts are not audited.
